findings.title: Import stores unsanitized remote HTML as raw_html posts
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import creates posts with skip_validations and cook_method raw_html from fetched/RSS content. Post#cook returns raw for this method and the embed view outputs post.cooked with `raw`, so untrusted HTML from the remote page/feed is stored and rendered without sanitization. This can lead to stored XSS, for example via javascript: links or other active content.

findings.title: Invalid ERB block terminator `<%- end if %>`
findings.body: The template closes the if/else block with `<%- end if %>`. ERB will emit `end if` into the Ruby code, which is not a valid way to terminate an if block, so the template will fail to compile/render. It should be `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: Referer is interpolated into inline JavaScript unsafely
findings.body: `request.referer` is inserted into an inline script string and used as the postMessage target origin without JavaScript escaping or reducing it to an origin. A referer containing special characters can break the script or be used in the wrong context. Use `escape_javascript` and send the message to `URI(request.referer).origin` rather than the full referer.

findings.title: Feed polling crashes when an item has no content
findings.body: Many RSS/Atom items do not provide a `content` field, for example RSS items with only `description`. `i.content` can be nil, so calling `.scrub` on it raises NoMethodError and aborts the whole poll job. Use a fallback field and guard against nil.

findings.title: Remote import uses open-uri without redirect or timeout restrictions
findings.body: `import_remote` fetches URLs with `open(url).read`. open-uri follows redirects and has no connect/read timeout by default. Since the URL can be triggered through embed retrieval, a redirect from an allowed host can be used to reach unintended hosts/internal services, and a slow endpoint can hang the job. Use a restricted HTTP client with timeouts and controlled redirects.

findings.title: Unknown embed URLs trigger a synchronous full feed poll
findings.body: When feed polling is enabled, each missing embed URL runs `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline. This downloads and imports the entire feed just to check for one URL. Anonymous embed requests can enqueue many RetrieveTopic jobs, throttled only per URL, causing repeated expensive feed polling and Sidekiq backlog.

findings.title: content_sha1 is updated even if the post revision fails
findings.body: In the update path, `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` is called after `revise!` without checking the result or rescuing save failures. If the revision does not persist, the embed record still records the new hash, so future imports will think the content is up to date and will not retry.

findings.title: Loading response is cached for one minute
findings.body: `discourse_expires_in 1.minute` is called even when the controller renders the loading page. If the loading response is cached, the iframe's 30-second reload can continue to show the cached loading page after the background job has created the topic. The loading state should be non-cacheable or expire much sooner.

findings.title: Throttle key set and expiry are not atomic
findings.body: `$redis.setnx` followed by `$redis.expire` is not atomic. If the process dies between the two commands, the key can remain forever without a TTL, permanently blocking retrieval for that embed URL. Use an atomic SET with NX and EX, or an equivalent atomic primitive.

findings.title: Blank embed_url is accepted and enqueues a failing job
findings.body: `params.require(:embed_url)` only requires the key to be present; an empty string passes. The controller then enqueues RetrieveTopic with a blank embed_url, and the job raises Discourse::InvalidParameters. Validate presence/non-blank before enqueuing.

findings.title: Embed URLs are not normalized before lookup/create
findings.body: TopicEmbed records are matched by exact `embed_url`. Equivalent URLs, such as http vs https, trailing slash differences, or harmless query/fragment variations, will be treated as different embeds and can create duplicate topics for the same article. Canonicalize URLs before lookup and storage.

findings.title: Only root-relative URLs are absolutized
findings.body: `absolutize_urls` rewrites only `href`/`src` values that start with `/`. Relative paths without a leading slash and protocol-relative URLs like `//host/...` are left unchanged, so imported posts can contain broken links/images. Resolve all relative URLs against the source URL.

findings.title: No guard when #discourse-comments is missing
findings.body: The script calls `comments.appendChild(iframe)` without checking whether `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` returned null. If the embedding page lacks that element, JavaScript throws and the embed iframe is never inserted.

findings.title: Assumes discourseUrl ends with a trailing slash
findings.body: The iframe src is built by concatenating `discourseUrl` with `embed/best...`. If `discourseUrl` does not end with `/`, the resulting URL is invalid, for example `https://forum.example.comembed/best`. Normalize the base URL before concatenating.

findings.title: create_table uses force: true
findings.body: `create_table :topic_embeds, force: true` will drop an existing `topic_embeds` table and its data before creating the new one. Production migrations should not silently drop tables; use `create_table` without `force` and handle pre-existing tables explicitly if needed.

findings.title: Existing migration changed to force table recreation
findings.body: This edits an existing migration and adds `force: true` to `create_table :top_topics`. If the migration is rerun or run after the table already exists, it will drop and recreate the table, causing data loss. Migrations should generally be immutable and not use force in this way.

findings.title: Loading page reloads forever if retrieval never succeeds
findings.body: The loading template reloads the page every 30 seconds indefinitely. If the embed cannot be retrieved due to an invalid URL, host mismatch, or remote errors, this creates an endless request loop on the embedding page. Add a failure state or backoff.

findings.title: Template assumes post.user is present
findings.body: The embed view calls `post.user.small_avatar_url` and `post.user.username` without nil checks. If a displayed post has a deleted or missing user, the template raises NoMethodError and the embed fails to render. Use a fallback user/display for nil users.

findings.title: Feed fetch has no timeout/error handling
findings.body: `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` is called without timeouts or rescue. A slow or unresponsive feed can hang the scheduled Sidekiq job and delay other scheduled work. Use an HTTP client with connect/read timeouts and handle fetch errors.
